description: This is a PHP class source file defining the ReturnAction model for the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing return action entities in the database.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Model class for managing return actions, including create, read, update, delete, and multilingual descriptions in the database.

methods.name: addReturnAction
methods.description: Creates a new return action record with multilingual support and returns its ID.

methods.name: editReturnAction
methods.description: Updates an existing return action record by deleting old data and adding new descriptions.

methods.name: deleteReturnAction
methods.description: Deletes a return action record by ID.

methods.name: deleteReturnActionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return actions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getReturnAction
methods.description: Retrieves a single return action record by ID, considering current language.

methods.name: getReturnActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return actions with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReturnActions
methods.description: Returns the total count of return actions, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a return action in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific description of a return action in a particular language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions of a return action across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return action descriptions for a specific language.
